senses.en: a departure from what is normal or expected

ex.en: The poor test score was an aberration for a student who usually earned top marks.
ex.zh: 對一個平常總拿高分的學生來說，這次考不好只是個意外。

root.note: 偏離正路 → 異常

senses.en: moderate or restrained, especially in eating and drinking

ex.en: My grandfather credits his long life to his abstemious habits.
ex.zh: 我祖父認為他長壽是因為飲食很有節制。

parts.m: strong drink 烈酒（拉丁文 temetum）

root.note: 遠離烈酒 → 節制的

mn: 開頭是 abs（腹肌）：想練出腹肌，飲食就得有節制。

senses.en: to accept or agree to something reluctantly but without protest

ex.en: The manager refused at first but eventually had to acquiesce to the union's demands.
ex.zh: 經理起初拒絕，但最後不得不默許工會的要求。

root.note: 安靜下來、不再反對 → 默許

mn: 中間的 quie 就是 quiet：安安靜靜地接受，就是默許。

senses.en: bitterness or ill feeling, especially in speech or manner

ex.en: The divorce was settled without acrimony, and the couple remained friends.
ex.zh: 這場離婚沒有鬧得很難看，兩人仍然是朋友。

root.note: 又尖又苦的態度 → 尖刻

senses.en: refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind

ex.en: She was adamant that she had locked the door before leaving.
ex.zh: 她堅稱出門前有鎖門。

parts.m: to tame 馴服（希臘文 daman）

root.note: 無法被馴服 → 原指極堅硬的石頭，引申為堅定不移

senses.en: to warn or reprimand someone firmly

ex.en: The librarian had to admonish the students for talking too loudly.
ex.zh: 圖書館員不得不告誡那些學生說話太大聲。

root.note: 對人提出警告 → 告誡

senses.en: to have an influence on; to make a difference to
to pretend to have or feel

ex.en: Even a small change in temperature can affect how the plants grow.
ex.zh: 即使只是溫度的小變化，也可能影響植物的生長。

root.note: 對某物做了些什麼 → 影響

mn: affect 是動詞（Action 開頭 A）；effect 是結果（End 開頭 E）。

senses.en: brisk and cheerful readiness

ex.en: She accepted the invitation with alacrity, eager to see her old friends.
ex.zh: 她爽快地接受邀請，迫不及待想見老朋友。

parts.m: lively 活潑的（拉丁文 alacer）

root.note: 活潑輕快的狀態 → 爽快

mn: 把它想成「a-lack-rity」的反面：一點都不 lack（缺乏）熱情。

senses.en: to make suffering, a problem, or difficulty less severe

ex.en: The nurse gave him medicine to alleviate the pain.
ex.zh: 護士給他藥來減輕疼痛。

root.note: 使變輕 → 減輕

senses.en: open to more than one interpretation; not clear
senses.zh: 模稜兩可的；含糊不清的

ex.en: The ending of the novel is ambiguous, so readers still argue about what really happened.
ex.zh: 這本小說的結局模稜兩可，所以讀者到現在還在爭論到底發生了什麼事。

root.note: 被推往兩個方向 → 模稜兩可

senses.en: to make something bad or unsatisfactory better

ex.en: The city built new shelters to ameliorate living conditions for the homeless.
ex.zh: 市政府蓋了新的收容所，改善遊民的生活條件。

root.note: 使變得更好 → 改善

senses.en: well-meaning and kindly; generous in helping others

ex.en: A benevolent stranger paid for the family's groceries.
ex.zh: 一位好心的陌生人替這家人付了買菜的錢。

root.note: 懷著好的意願 → 仁慈的

senses.en: a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause

ex.en: An anonymous benefactor donated a million dollars to the school library.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐助者捐了一百萬美元給學校圖書館。

root.note: 做好事的人 → 捐助者

senses.en: gentle and kindly
(of a disease or tumor) not harmful

ex.en: The doctor was relieved to find that the tumor was benign.
ex.zh: 醫生發現腫瘤是良性的，鬆了一口氣。

parts.m: good 好（在這個字裡拼成 beni）

root.note: 天生善良 → 和善的、良性的

senses.en: favorable or advantageous; producing good results

ex.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to both body and mind.
ex.zh: 規律運動對身心都有益。

root.note: 帶來好處的 → 有益的

senses.en: to support or strengthen
a long, thick pillow

ex.en: The coach's speech helped bolster the team's confidence before the final.
ex.zh: 教練的談話在決賽前幫忙提振了球隊的信心。

root.note: 用長枕墊高 → 支撐、加強

senses.en: a harsh, unpleasant mixture of sounds

ex.en: The cacophony of car horns made it impossible to think.
ex.zh: 此起彼落的汽車喇叭聲吵得讓人沒辦法思考。

root.note: 難聽的聲音 → 噪音

senses.en: the quality of being open and honest

ex.en: I appreciated her candor when she told me my essay needed more work.
ex.zh: 她坦白告訴我作文還需要修改，我很感謝她的直率。

root.note: 潔白發亮 → 純潔、坦白（candle 蠟燭同源）

senses.en: to criticize or reprimand severely

ex.en: Critics were quick to castigate the director for the film's lazy plot.
ex.zh: 影評人很快就嚴厲批評導演，說這部片的劇情很草率。

parts.m: drive, make 使（拉丁文 agere）

root.note: 使之純潔 → 懲戒、嚴厲糾正

senses.en: careful to consider all risks before acting

ex.en: Investors have become more circumspect since last year's market crash.
ex.zh: 去年股市崩盤之後，投資人變得更謹慎了。

root.note: 往四周看清楚 → 謹慎的

senses.en: clear, logical, and convincing
senses.zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的

ex.en: She presented a cogent argument for keeping the library open on weekends.
ex.zh: 她提出很有說服力的論點，主張圖書館週末也要開放。

root.note: 把人推到同一個結論 → 有說服力的

senses.en: too satisfied with oneself and unaware of possible dangers

ex.en: After three straight wins, the team grew complacent and stopped practicing hard.
ex.zh: 連贏三場之後，球隊變得自滿，不再認真練習。

root.note: 對自己非常滿意 → 自滿的

mn: 別和 complaisant（殷勤順從的）搞混：complacent 是對自己滿意，complaisant 是想讓別人滿意。

senses.en: a thing that completes or goes well with something else
to add to something in a way that improves it

ex.en: The spicy sauce is a perfect complement to the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 這種辣醬和烤魚是絕配。

root.note: 把缺的填滿 → 補充

mn: complEment 讓東西完整（complEte）；complIment 是「I」說好話稱讚你。

senses.en: to confirm or give support to a statement or theory

ex.en: Security camera footage helped corroborate the witness's story.
ex.zh: 監視器畫面幫忙證實了目擊者的說法。

root.note: 使更有力量 → 證實（robust 強壯的同源）

senses.en: too ready to believe things; easily fooled

ex.en: The scam targeted credulous customers who believed they had won a prize.
ex.zh: 這個騙局專找容易輕信的顧客，讓他們以為自己中了獎。

root.note: 太容易相信 → 輕信的

mn: credible 是「別人信得過」，credulous 是「自己太好騙」。

senses.en: a scarcity or lack of something

ex.en: There is a dearth of qualified teachers in rural areas.
ex.zh: 鄉村地區缺乏合格的教師。

root.note: 東西稀少所以珍貴 → 缺乏

mn: dear + th：東西少了才變得 dear（珍貴）。

senses.en: causing harm or damage

ex.en: Smoking has a deleterious effect on nearly every organ in the body.
ex.zh: 吸菸對身體幾乎每個器官都有害。

parts.m: destroyer 破壞者（希臘文 dēlētēr）

root.note: 具破壞性的 → 有害的

mn: 聯想 delete（刪除）：會把你刪掉的東西當然有害。

senses.en: to speak of someone or something as having little value

ex.en: Good leaders do not disparage the ideas of their team members.
ex.zh: 好的領導者不會貶低團隊成員的想法。

root.note: 使降到不平等的地位 → 貶低

senses.en: cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 熱情洋溢的；興高采烈的

ex.en: The ebullient host greeted every guest with a hug.
ex.zh: 熱情洋溢的主人擁抱迎接每一位客人。

root.note: 沸騰到冒出來 → 熱情洋溢

mn: bull 像 bubble：情緒像滾水一樣冒泡泡。

senses.en: outstandingly bad; shocking

ex.en: Copying an entire essay from the internet is an egregious violation of school rules.
ex.zh: 從網路上抄一整篇文章，是嚴重違反校規的行為。

root.note: 超出群體 → 原意是「傑出的」，後來轉成貶義「惡劣得出眾」

senses.en: open to more than one interpretation, often to avoid commitment
senses.zh: 模稜兩可的；含糊其詞的

ex.en: The senator gave an equivocal answer that pleased neither side.
ex.zh: 那位參議員給了一個模稜兩可的回答，兩邊都不滿意。

root.note: 兩種聲音一樣大 → 模稜兩可

senses.en: having or showing great knowledge from study

ex.en: The erudite professor could quote poetry in five languages.
ex.zh: 那位博學的教授能用五種語言引用詩句。

root.note: 去除粗野 → 受過教育、博學的（rude 同源）

senses.en: to make a problem, bad situation, or feeling worse

ex.en: Scratching the rash will only exacerbate the itching.
ex.zh: 抓疹子只會讓癢更嚴重。

root.note: 弄得更苦澀 → 使惡化

senses.en: very attentive to detail and hard to please

ex.en: He is so fastidious about his desk that he lines up his pencils by length.
ex.zh: 他對書桌非常講究，連鉛筆都照長短排好。

root.note: 對很多東西都嫌惡 → 挑剔的

senses.en: excessively talkative, especially about unimportant things

ex.en: The garrulous passenger next to me talked for the entire six-hour flight.
ex.zh: 我旁邊那位多話的乘客，在六小時的航程中說個不停。

root.note: 一直嘰嘰喳喳 → 喋喋不休

mn: 唸起來像「嘎嘎嘎」叫個不停。

senses.en: fond of company; sociable
(of animals) living in groups

ex.en: Being gregarious, Maya made dozens of friends in her first week of college.
ex.zh: Maya 很愛交朋友，上大學第一週就交了好幾十個朋友。

root.note: 喜歡待在群體裡 → 愛交際的

senses.en: a person who attacks cherished beliefs or traditional institutions
senses.zh: 打破傳統的人；反傳統者

ex.en: A true iconoclast, the young architect ignored every traditional design rule.
ex.zh: 這位年輕建築師是真正的反傳統者，完全不理會傳統設計規則。

root.note: 打破聖像的人 → 挑戰傳統的人

senses.en: acting quickly without thinking or care

ex.en: In an impetuous moment, he quit his job without having another one lined up.
ex.zh: 他一時衝動，在還沒找到下一份工作前就辭職了。

root.note: 猛然衝上前 → 衝動的

senses.en: tending to talk a great deal

ex.en: My loquacious uncle can turn a simple question into a two-hour story.
ex.zh: 我那個話多的叔叔能把一個簡單的問題變成兩小時的故事。

root.note: 說很多話的 → 多話的

senses.en: having or showing a wish to do evil to others

ex.en: The villain gave a malevolent smile as he locked the door.
ex.zh: 反派一邊鎖門，一邊露出惡毒的笑容。

root.note: 懷著壞的意願 → 惡毒的

senses.en: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
senses.zh: 一絲不苟的；極其仔細的

ex.en: The scientist kept meticulous records of every experiment.
ex.zh: 那位科學家把每一次實驗都記錄得一絲不苟。

root.note: 怕出錯 → 非常仔細

senses.en: too eager to please or obey

ex.en: The obsequious waiter kept refilling our glasses and praising our choices.
ex.zh: 那個諂媚的服務生一直幫我們倒水，還一直稱讚我們點得好。

root.note: 一直跟在別人後面 → 諂媚的

senses.en: extremely unwilling to spend money

ex.en: The parsimonious landlord refused to fix the broken heater.
ex.zh: 吝嗇的房東拒絕修理壞掉的暖氣。

root.note: 什麼都要省 → 吝嗇的

mn: 想成 parse money：每一分錢都要仔細分析才肯花。

senses.en: not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily
senses.zh: 沉默寡言的；有所保留的

ex.en: He was reticent about his past and rarely talked about his childhood.
ex.zh: 他對過去總是有所保留，很少提起童年。

parts.m: be silent 沉默（拉丁文 tacere）

root.note: 一直保持沉默 → 沉默寡言

senses.en: a person who flatters powerful people to gain advantage

ex.en: Every sycophant in the office laughed loudly at the boss's terrible joke.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡每個馬屁精都對老闆超冷的笑話哈哈大笑。

parts.m: fig 無花果（希臘文 sykon）

root.note: 原指「告密者」，後來轉成巴結討好的人

mn: 唸起來像 sick of fan：對老闆「死忠粉」到讓人想吐。

senses.en: understood or implied without being stated

ex.en: By not objecting, the teacher gave tacit approval to the plan.
ex.zh: 老師沒有反對，等於默許了這個計畫。

root.note: 在沉默中表示 → 心照不宣

senses.en: present, appearing, or found everywhere
senses.zh: 無所不在的；到處都是的

ex.en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even among young children.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機已經無所不在，連小孩子都有。

root.note: 到處都在 → 無所不在

senses.en: to keep changing between different opinions or actions

ex.en: I vacillate between wanting to study law and wanting to study art.
ex.zh: 我一直在想念法律還是念藝術之間搖擺不定。

root.note: 來回搖晃 → 猶豫不決

senses.en: the woman who is head of a convent

ex.en: The abbess welcomed the travelers into the quiet convent.
ex.zh: 女修道院院長歡迎旅人進入寧靜的修道院。

parts.m: father 父親（abbot 修道院院長）

root.note: 女性的修道院院長

senses.en: the science of gases at rest and of balloons and airships that float in air

ex.en: Early balloon makers had to understand aerostatics to keep their craft in the air.
ex.zh: 早期製作熱氣球的人必須懂氣體靜力學，才能讓氣球留在空中。

root.note: 研究空氣靜止狀態的學問
